epegRNA_extension_specification.why_prime_or_cgbe_not_abe8e: c.3310C>G (g.10352442G>C) is a C:G -> G:C base transversion; adenine base editors (ABE8e) only catalyze A:T -> G:C transitions and cannot install C:G -> G:C transversions (closing AUDIT-REF). Moreover, because this + strand protospacer places 10352442G inside the 3' GGG PAM (+22), it is specifically a PEmax prime-editing guide rather than a 5'-window CGBE1 guide (closing AUDIT-REF). On the minus strand (where chr19:10352432-10352434 (-) is 5'-GGT-3' and chr19:10352436-10352438 (-) is 5'-CCA-3'), the nearest canonical 5'-NGG-3' PAMs are 5'-AGG-3' at chr19:10352422-10352424 (-) (placing 10352442C at protospacer position 3) and 5'-CGG-3' at chr19:10352433-10352435 (-) (placing 10352442C at protospacer position 14), both outside the CGBE1 nt 4-7 deamination window, so CGBE1 requires an SpG (5'-AGC-3' PAM at chr19:10352426-10352428 -, position 7) or SpRY (5'-GCC-3' PAM at chr19:10352425-10352427 -, position 6) variant (closing AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF & R9-S1-L5B [DEC-074]).

editing_complexity_and_manufacturing_acc.two_pass_clonal_mcb_release_qc_policy: Assigned-rule scenario values in evaluate_regimen_survival_probability are conditioned on a hypothetical release-qualified Master Cell Bank (MCB) clone that has passed two-pass clonal screening (2 chromosomal loci x 2 homologous alleles = 4 target alleles per pass), junction-spanning AAV6 ITR-capture ddPCR (<0.1% vector-backbone/ITR concavemer or off-locus capture at CIITA/CXCL10/AAVS1; Hanlon et al. 2019 PMID:31570731; AUDIT-REF & D6-F03), >=63,000x TP53 duplex-seq (>=62,958 independent duplex molecules), and 20q11.21 ddPCR. Physical uncloned yield is unmeasured. The separate dimensionless engineering utility discount is exp(-lambda_K * max(0, K - 4)) * gamma_B ** B; it is not manufacturing yield or a fitted clinical probability.

tyk2_independent_autoimmune_memory_and_i.tyk2_p1104a_pathway_scope: TYK2 P1104A (rs34536443 C/C) selectively dampens Type-I IFN (IFN-alpha/beta via IFNAR1/TYK2-JAK1) and IL-12/IL-23 signaling, but does NOT block IFN-gamma signaling (which signals exclusively through IFNGR1/IFNGR2 via JAK1 + JAK2, independent of TYK2) nor TNF-alpha / IL-1beta NF-kB/JNK pro-apoptotic signaling, and does NOT prevent host recipient APCs from phagocytosing shed beta-cell autoantigens (PPI, GAD65, IA-2, ZnT8, HIPs) for indirect presentation on recipient HLA-DR3-DQ2 / HLA-DQ8 to autoreactive CD4+ helper T cells.
tyk2_independent_autoimmune_memory_and_i.orthogonal_protection_layers_required: Protection against TYK2-independent IFN-gamma/TNF-alpha + indirect DR3/DQ8 CD4+ autoimmunity relies on: (1) CXCL10-inducible (or L3-BF-B basal-floor) cytosolic SERPINB9 + surface PD-L1 (harnessing local IFN-gamma/STAT1 to upregulate granzyme-B/PD-1 defense), (2) peri-implant SA-FasL / SA-THBD microgel + Treg co-delivery to induce apoptosis of infiltrating Fas+ CD4+ Teff and foster FoxP3+ Treg conversion, and (3) Stage-0 Gate 0C-kinetic verification under combined IFN-gamma + TNF-alpha + IL-1beta + DR3/DQ8 PBMC transwell co-culture.

engineered_and_polymorphic_point_variant.numbering_and_functional_non_equivalence: AlphaMissense scores evolutionary/structural single-missense constraint on native full-length human proteins and does NOT measure engineered bump-hole pharmacology, GPI-stalk folding, somatic clonal expansion, oncogenic transformation, or MHC peptide presentation. Canonical Blueprint A CD47-IgV-GPI retains WT mature Cys15 (precursor Cys33), whereas Challenger Arm 1X carries mature C15G (precursor CD47 C33G = 0.9646; C33S = 0.9945; C33A = 0.9943) deliberately removing the unpaired partner of deleted transmembrane Cys263. Likewise, iCasp9 mature FKBP12(F36V) corresponds to initiator-Met-inclusive FKBP1A F37V = 0.9363 (Clackson et al. 1998 PMID:9724721; Di Stasi et al. 2011 PMID:22047558), Design B'-SCT HLA-C mature Y84A corresponds to precursor Y108A = 0.6972 (Y84C/Y108C = 0.3940, A139C/A163C = 0.7645, T143A/T167A = 0.2728; Finton et al. 2023 PMID:37207206), and protective hypomorphic TYK2 P1104A scores 0.8292 (Dendrou et al. 2016 PMID:27807284; Boisson-Dupuis et al. 2018 PMID:30578352; Chandra et al. 2022 PMID:36289205).
